headline: Aarong to hire 500 Sales Associates; apply by October 20 for positions across Bangladesh
summary: Aarong, a popular lifestyle brand of BRAC, has announced a large-scale recruitment drive for 500 Sales Associate positions. Interested candidates can apply online by October 20.
details: Aarong, BRAC's popular lifestyle brand, has issued a large-scale recruitment notice for 500 Sales Associate positions. Interested candidates can apply online by October 20.

The required educational qualification is Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent from any recognized institution. Applicants should have knowledge of product features, benefits, and care instructions.

Other qualifications include understanding inventory counting and tracking, as well as sales strategies to assist customers in product selection. Responsibilities involve greeting customers, helping them choose products, and providing accurate information.

Sales Associates will also be responsible for accurately completing transactions in the Point of Sales system, answering customer queries, and resolving issues promptly. They must coordinate with team members to achieve targets and manage back-store operations.

The job locations span across multiple cities, including Barishal, Bogura, Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Cumilla, Dhaka (Savar), Dinajpur, Faridpur, Feni, Jashore (Jashore Sadar), Khulna, Kushtia, Noakhali, Rajshahi, and Rangpur.

headline: SSC pass can apply for marine apprentice course under BIWTA, 370 seats available
summary: The one-year course offers free accommodation, food, and training, with opportunities for both domestic and international maritime careers.
details: Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority (BIWTA) has announced admissions for its one-year Marine Apprentice (Deck and Engine) course for the 2027 academic year. Bangladeshi male citizens who have passed SSC or equivalent can apply for the 370 available seats.
Training for this course is set to begin on January 1. Applications are open from the date of the announcement until midnight on October 31.
Selected candidates will receive free accommodation, food, and training. They will also be provided with a free set of uniforms suitable for the training.
Applications must be submitted online. Applicants need to select their preferred training institutions in order of priority and specify one of the three examination centers for the admission test.

The application fee is BDT 320, payable via Dutch-Bangla Bank's Rocket mobile banking. The written examination will cover Bengali, English, Mathematics, and General Knowledge, all at SSC level, totaling 100 marks.

Candidates who pass the written exam must then undergo physical fitness, eye, swimming, and oral examinations. From those who pass, the top 140 for the Deck branch and 130 for the Engine branch will be finally selected based on merit. Others will be placed on a waiting list.
A one-time fee of BDT 20,000 and a security deposit of BDT 2,000 are required at the time of admission. The security deposit will be refunded upon successful completion of the course.

Upon completion of the training, there are job opportunities on inland vessels. Trainees also have the chance to be promoted to First Class Inland Master, Inland Driver, or Inland Marine Engineer during their service.

Additionally, trainees who have passed Secondary (Science) or equivalent examinations with Physics and Mathematics from a recognized board/authority, with a minimum GPA of 3.00 (50% marks), will be eligible for jobs on foreign-going ships after obtaining a Deck/Engine Officer Class-5 certificate.
caption:
